queryFamilies.purpose: Test whether a neutral e-invoice readiness product can control regulated transmission or whether accredited platforms absorb the workflow
queries: France accredited e-invoice platform authority and sanctions
France B2B e-invoice external specifications APIs XSD Swagger 2026
queryFamilies.decisionImpact: The regulated transport/control plane belongs to accredited platforms and published standards reduce basic mapping scarcity; a generic readiness map remains low-value unless narrowed to cross-provider exceptions or independent verification.

queryFamilies.purpose: Test system-outage and blocked-shipment assumptions for CATCH
queries: CATCH official outage contingency templates 2026
CATCH interoperability access and importer workflow
queryFamilies.decisionImpact: Official contingency templates partially absorb the outage-resilience thesis. Remaining value must concern pre-submission correctness or post-recovery reconciliation, not merely service unavailability.

queryFamilies.purpose: Identify which CohortPreflight functions the public EHDS platform is already designed to provide
queries: HealthData@EU central platform dataset catalogue search access application
EHDS national catalogue metadata implementation status
queryFamilies.decisionImpact: Public dataset search and request submission directly absorb a generic catalogue/front-door. Any private wedge must add cross-catalogue data quality, study-specific feasibility, or workflow evidence unavailable in the public primitive.

queryFamilies.purpose: Seek operator-side negative evidence beyond the directive text
queries: European repair platform implementation 2026 repairer pain spare parts part pairing
right to repair 2026 national implementation barriers
queryFamilies.decisionImpact: Stakeholder evidence says national implementation is incomplete and highlights parts pricing/part pairing/product-scope gaps. This supports WAIT_FOR_TRIGGER, not a clearing-network demand claim.

queryFamilies.purpose: Determine whether rail telematics is signal, specification, or migration and whether an existing idea is already mapped
queries: ERA new Telematics Applications TSI entry into force APIs ontology implementation 2026
rail telematics passenger freight implementation guide vendors conformance
queryFamilies.decisionImpact: The market is in a live migration/interoperability phase, but no canonical venture is linked and no buyer/WTP evidence was collected; status remains REASSESS rather than generating a new idea.

queryFamilies.purpose: Test whether duplicate and speculative electricity-load queues create a neutral identity product or are becoming utility-owned admission controls
queries: DOE large-load interconnection duplicate speculative requests and readiness
FERC large-load interconnection co-location duplicate requests readiness deposits
EPRI large-load interconnection queue readiness data centres
commercial large-load interconnection queue-management software
queryFamilies.decisionImpact: The pain is official and current, but FERC-directed escalating readiness and site-control gates put authority with RTOs, ISOs, and utilities. DemandProof must be an evidence exchange or interoperability layer; it cannot assume control of admission.

queryFamilies.purpose: Test whether PFAS-media lifetime is a repeatable data problem and whether a public model absorbs the analytical wedge
queries: EPA PFAS granular activated carbon ion exchange breakthrough performance monitoring
EPA GAC pilot-scale full-scale replacement interval model
official PFAS treatment modelling software and media-replacement service
queryFamilies.decisionImpact: Site, water-matrix, PFAS, media, and operating variation support the problem. EPA's open ETDOT and pore-surface diffusion methods absorb a model-only product, leaving a possible operational-data and continuous-calibration wedge that has not been commercially validated.

queryFamilies.purpose: Resolve the legislative phase and whether medicine-resilience criteria create a live procurement gate
queries: European Commission Critical Medicines Act procurement resilience criteria 2025
Council Critical Medicines Act political agreement 2026 procurement resilience
pharmaceutical supply-chain resilience procurement software API origin
queryFamilies.decisionImpact: A provisional co-legislator agreement would require resilience-related procurement criteria, but formal adoption and buyer-specific scoring remain outstanding. MedicineResilience Twin stays WAIT_FOR_TRIGGER rather than earning a live conformance claim.

queryFamilies.purpose: Test IRIS2 and EU Space Act demand against programme concentration, ESA tools, standards, and engineering incumbents
queries: European Commission IRIS2 concession SpaceRISE satellites services
ESA IRIS2 programme launch and service schedule
EU Space Act debris safety official
ESA Zero Debris standards tools software
satellite mission-assurance debris-compliance software
queryFamilies.decisionImpact: Lifecycle evidence demand is emerging, but IRIS2 is prime-led and ESA already supplies DRAMA, verification guidance, matrices, templates, and professional portals. A broad compliance engine is highly absorbable; only change-impact evidence across existing tools remains plausible.

queryFamilies.purpose: Test whether AI-research provenance benefits from new public infrastructure and whether open-source standards already cover the core capture layer
queries: EuroHPC AI Factories access services research SMEs
official open-source research provenance RO-Crate Workflow Run Crate
MLflow model tracking prompts datasets official repository
DVC experiment tracking data versioning reproducibility
queryFamilies.decisionImpact: Public compute access increases AI-assisted research volume, but MLflow and RO-Crate already cover much of prompt, model, dataset, workflow, and provenance capture. ResearchProof should not proceed as a generic recorder; an institution-enforced evidence or submission gate would need direct buyer proof.

queryFamilies.purpose: Seek counterevidence to the assumption that EU compliance surfaces only expand
queries: European Commission simplification omnibus 2026 CBAM sustainability reporting
Council omnibus simplification CBAM final adopted
queryFamilies.decisionImpact: Adopted CBAM and sustainability simplifications show abrupt demand destruction is real. Regulatory ventures must model scope contraction and not capitalize the entire originally announced obligated population.

queryFamilies.purpose: Test whether the Data Act creates a scarce unified machine-data API or whether standards and industrial platforms absorb connectivity
queries: European Commission Data Act industrial machinery raw preprocessed data access
AWS IoT SiteWise OPC UA MQTT industrial protocol partners
OPC Foundation industrial interoperability information models
queryFamilies.decisionImpact: The access right is live and applies to industrial machinery, but it is bounded to readily available raw/pre-processed data. Existing hyperscaler and protocol ecosystems absorb generic connectivity, so MachineKey is reassessed toward repeated OEM-specific semantic, permission, and portability gaps only.

queryFamilies.purpose: Distinguish real detention/demurrage losses from a defensible automated recovery product
queries: US DOT truck driver detention learning agenda economic loss
FMC detention demurrage invoice dispute final rule
GPS detention billing evidence recovery software
freight audit payment network incumbent scale
queryFamilies.decisionImpact: The economic pain and invoice boundary are real. GPS evidence, billing packets, audit, payment, and exceptions already have specialised and scaled providers, so FreightRecover's generic recovery thesis is reassessed down pending claim-level residual outcome data.

queryFamilies.purpose: Test whether late-payment prevalence and policy create a standalone recovery network despite ERP and AR-suite automation
queries: European Commission 2026 SME late payments 73 percent
European Parliament late payment regulation legislative status June 2026
SAP accounts receivable AI collections disputes promise to pay
queryFamilies.decisionImpact: Late payments remain widespread, but the stronger EU regime is not an adopted operational gate and SAP bundles the generic workflow. PayMe is killed as a broad autonomous agent and retained only as a search for segment-specific incremental recovery outside incumbent coverage.

queryFamilies.purpose: Separate a long-tail B2B adapter wedge from emerging trust/payment protocols and established supplier networks
queries: Visa Trusted Agent Protocol specification merchant agent trust
Google AP2 UCP agent authorization payment protocol
SAP Business Network supplier catalogs purchase orders cXML EDI
queryFamilies.decisionImpact: Trust, authorization, payment, catalog, order, and invoice rails are rapidly standardising or already network-owned. B2B Agent Gateway remains WAIT and must prove a repeatable long-tail catalog/quote/terms/exception gap rather than claim the whole control plane.

queryFamilies.purpose: Test whether low-water capacity scarcity supports an enforceable option marketplace rather than incumbent surcharges and contingency routing
queries: CCNR Rhine low water freight rates 2026
Contargo Rhine low water surcharge gauge capacity modal switch
queryFamilies.decisionImpact: Current low water creates severe and observable capacity/pricing stress, but carrier-published gauge ladders, bilateral by-agreement pricing, and modal switching already govern the response. The neutral option marketplace is killed until both sides provide enforceable term sheets.

queryFamilies.purpose: Test whether fragmented scientific-infrastructure access leaves an unowned capacity-routing layer or is governed by facility controls and established research marketplaces
queries: European Commission technology infrastructures industrial access charter 2026
Argonne APS beam time proposal safety access
Scientist.com research marketplace providers contracts compliance
Science Exchange platform sourcing compliance contracts payments
queryFamilies.decisionImpact: The EU acknowledges fragmented access and has adopted a voluntary charter, but facility-level science review, safety, contracts, and IP remain authoritative. Scientist.com and Science Exchange already provide broad sourcing and procurement, so LabGrid is killed as a generic marketplace and retained only as a search for a specific underserved public-facility corridor.

queryFamilies.purpose: Determine whether laboratory software exit risk can be measured consistently and whether standards or vendor exports absorb a generic index
queries: Allotrope Data Format analytical data metadata audit trail
SiLA standards laboratory device LIMS ELN integration
Benchling export project notebook registry inventory audit log
eLabFTW ELN RO-Crate export restore backup
LabArchives offline notebook PDF attachment export
queryFamilies.decisionImpact: Open standards and documented exports absorb a generic portability score, while materially different formats and attachment/audit behavior make a vendor-agnostic score unsafe. Lab Software Exit-Risk Index is narrowed to evidence-based export completeness and restoration drills against a declared object inventory.

queryFamilies.purpose: Test whether a neutral consumables compatibility graph owns scarce data or duplicates OEM selectors while assuming unsafe substitution liability
queries: Thermo Fisher chromatography consumables cross reference compatibility disclaimer
Agilent LC column selector chemistry temperature USP
queryFamilies.decisionImpact: OEM selectors and cross references already cover much of discovery, while suitability remains the customer's responsibility. The broad neutral compatibility graph is killed; only provenance-backed method-transfer and requalification evidence could re-enter after a bounded lab test.

queryFamilies.purpose: Test whether TenderFactory can own discovery, qualification, and submission despite public schemas, services, and portal authority
queries: EU eProcurement vocabularies eForms ontology
European Commission digital procurement eSubmission ESPD eCertis once only
queryFamilies.decisionImpact: Machine-readable public schemas and Commission services absorb discovery, normalization, evidence reuse, and major submission primitives. Portal credentials and bidder authority remain controlling, so broad autonomous TenderFactory is killed; a single-jurisdiction qualification-exception wedge would require observed failed bids and buyer proof.

queryFamilies.purpose: Test whether independent activity-to-invoice auditing is unserved or already available from buyer-side auditors and WMS/TMS billing products
queries: 3PL rate card invoice audit overcharge recovery
CartonCloud 3PL billing invoicing rate card WMS TMS
3PL activity invoice discrepancy software
queryFamilies.decisionImpact: A direct buyer-side audit/recovery service and system-of-record activity billing already implement the thesis from both sides. The broad 3PL Activity-to-Invoice Grid is killed unless a multi-3PL historical invoice corpus proves a repeatable, collectible residual missed by both classes.

queryFamilies.purpose: Test whether public-data schema and quality monitoring is scarce or already provided by official machine-readable catalogues and validation services
queries: data.europa.eu OpenAPI metadata quality SHACL API
European Data Portal data quality accessibility availability guidelines
queryFamilies.decisionImpact: Official OpenAPI, metadata-quality, and SHACL services absorb generic catalogue/schema monitoring. Public Data Contract Watch is killed broadly and may re-enter only for consumer-specific impact mapping on an observed high-value public API break.

queryFamilies.purpose: Determine whether non-euro Verification of Payee needs an independent simulator or whether scheme-owned conformance tooling already controls the test boundary
queries: EPC Verification of Payee API Reference Toolbox test cases 2026
ECB Instant Payments Regulation non-euro Verification of Payee 2027
queryFamilies.decisionImpact: The EPC already owns positive/negative inter-PSP compliance testing and the non-euro deadline is fixed for July 2027. Instant-Payment Reality Grid is reassessed down to cross-RVM production exception observation that the reference toolbox does not reproduce.

queryFamilies.purpose: Test whether independent agent-purchase middleware owns a control plane beyond open mandates, merchant recognition, delegated payments, and network authorization
queries: AP2 agent authorization open mandates constraint types
Visa Trusted Agent Protocol merchant recognition
OpenAI Agentic Commerce Protocol delegated payments
Mastercard Agent Pay agentic tokens
queryFamilies.decisionImpact: Mandates, recognition signatures, delegated payments, and network controls absorb generic purchase middleware. AI-Agent Purchase Guardrail is killed broadly and may re-enter only for merchant/procurement policy exceptions with accepted authority and transaction-level failure evidence.

queryFamilies.purpose: Test whether autonomous repair is a scarce capability after API governance and contract testing, and whether a third party can infer provider intent safely
queries: MuleSoft API governance conformance REST AsyncAPI gRPC MCP agents
Postman contract tests API compatibility breaking changes
OpenAPI breaking change diff consumer contract
queryFamilies.decisionImpact: Governance, conformance, and compatibility detection are already incumbent capabilities. Autonomous mutation has no provider authority and can silently change transaction meaning, so Self-Maintaining Third-Party API Layer is killed except for human-approved consumer-impact patches.

queryFamilies.purpose: Separate free procurement/provenance/switching primitives from the ability to rebuild, sign, recover, and operate critical technology independently
queries: SLSA verified reproducible build limitations closed source
NIST 800-161 maintenance source code test cases access
EU Data Act cloud switching interfaces charges 12 January 2027
CISA Software Acquisition Guide Supplier Response Web Tool
queryFamilies.decisionImpact: Free guidance, supplier questionnaires, provenance, and switching rights absorb documentary scoring. They do not prove rebuild/signing/license/hardware/operation continuity. FreedomToModify continues only as an authorized executed drill with observable recovery outcomes.

queryFamilies.purpose: Test whether a neutral change fingerprint owns the machinery-safety decision or whether law, OEM signatures, and qualified conformity review retain authority
queries: EU Regulation 2023/1230 substantial modification digital means software safety
Siemens safety PLC collective signature acceptance
queryFamilies.decisionImpact: The 2027 regulation makes digital safety changes consequential, but OEM tools already fingerprint accepted safety programs and a signature change is not a conformity decision. Machine Safety State Drift Gate continues only as evidence assembly and routing to an authorized assessor, never automatic safe/unsafe adjudication.

queryFamilies.purpose: Determine whether calibration-interval optimization is a new scarce method or an established evidence-driven metrology workflow
queries: ILAC G24 OIML D10 recalibration interval guidance
NIST recommended calibration interval measurement history
queryFamilies.decisionImpact: ILAC/OIML and NIST already establish risk- and history-based interval methods. CalibraRisk waits unless a plant-specific workflow can integrate accredited results and obtain documented approval without claiming autonomous metrological authority.

queryFamilies.purpose: Verify the current legal status and determine whether a dismantling exception can be decided digitally without facility evidence
queries: EU Regulation 2026/1738 end-of-life vehicles parts removal feasibility excessive cost
EU vehicle circularity final adoption July 2026
queryFamilies.decisionImpact: The end-of-life vehicle rule is adopted rather than proposed, strengthening preparation work. The final text still makes removal feasibility, condition, treatment, and records physically and facility specific, so DismantleException waits for an authorized facility corpus and cannot automate the exception decision.

queryFamilies.purpose: Test whether sequence-screening software or benchmarking remains scarce after current policy revisions and free privacy-preserving tools
queries: US nucleic acid synthesis screening framework revision enforcement federal funding
IBBIS Common Mechanism free open source local DNA RNA screening
SecureDNA free privacy preserving synthesis screening
queryFamilies.decisionImpact: IBBIS and SecureDNA directly absorb generic screening and much benchmark infrastructure, while US policy is an evolving authoritative control. BioScreen Bench waits and may re-enter only for privacy-preserving operational assurance, customer-verification escalation, and policy-update evidence that does not publish evasion-sensitive material.

queryFamilies.purpose: Separate documentary reclaimed-refrigerant identity from physical composition and accredited purity evidence
queries: EU Regulation 2024/573 reclaimed refrigerant batch label quota
AHRI 700 reclaimed refrigerant purity analytical certification
queryFamilies.decisionImpact: EU batch/facility labels and AHRI analytical purity testing form complementary evidence. ReclaimProof continues only as cross-point chain-of-custody reconciliation anchored to certified lab results; a ledger or mass balance must never claim the physical identity or purity of a cylinder.

queryFamilies.purpose: Separate accessible product performance declarations from use-specific substitution and conformity authority
queries: Regulation EU 2024/3110 construction digital product passport declaration performance
EOTA European Technical Assessment intended use installed condition Technical Assessment Body
queryFamilies.decisionImpact: Public declarations and future passports absorb performance extraction, while designated assessment bodies and the responsible designer or manufacturer retain intended-use and system authority. The broad equivalence matrix waits; only a cited comparison packet routed for approval remains plausible.

queryFamilies.purpose: Test whether battery-passport data is sufficient for second-life valuation, safety, and market matching
queries: Regulation EU 2023/1542 battery passport state of health second life access
JRC second-life automotive batteries experimental state-of-health tests
queryFamilies.decisionImpact: The passport supplies controlled health, history, status, dismantling, and test information, but access is role-bounded and experimental qualification remains necessary. Battery Afterlife Exchange waits for repeatable physical qualification, liability, logistics, and two-sided liquidity rather than assuming passport data creates a market.

queryFamilies.purpose: Determine whether an independent neutral settlement rail can own mandatory wastewater EPR flows before national schemes are established
queries: Directive EU 2024/3019 urban wastewater extended producer responsibility 80 percent 2028
producer responsibility organisation approval financial guarantee micropollutant treatment
queryFamilies.decisionImpact: The forcing function is real and financially material, but Member States approve PROs and determine national contribution and allocation mechanics. The neutral clearinghouse waits for one implemented country, an authorized PRO, and actual producer/utility transaction data.

queryFamilies.purpose: Verify the small-dispenser deadline and distinguish message conformance from end-to-end physical and operational exception testing
queries: FDA DSCSA small dispenser exemption November 27 2026
GS1 DSCSA EPCIS conformance exception handling certified tester
queryFamilies.decisionImpact: The date is valid only for defined small dispensers, and GS1 already owns schemas, exception examples, and certified message conformance testing. RxTrace waits and narrows to authorized physical-package/data/quarantine reconciliation with software vendors or networks, not a $249 generic pharmacy schema test.

queryFamilies.purpose: Test whether official positive lists enable software-only compliance or merely preflight before required migration testing
queries: EU 2024/367 drinking water contact positive lists 31 December 2026
EU 2024/368 migration water testing ISO IEC 17025 pass fail
queryFamilies.decisionImpact: Official positive lists make rule preflight tractable, but final materials require condition-specific test pieces, migration-water analysis, and qualified pass/fail evidence. WaterContact continues only as confidential lab-intake and evidence-completeness orchestration, never an automated certificate.

queryFamilies.purpose: Test whether a neutral EU-wide gamete donor ledger can own family-limit and genetic-signal coordination
queries: Regulation EU 2024/1938 reproductive donor limits registries serious genetic condition communication
Implementing Regulation EU 2025/1467 EU SoHO Platform authenticated actors
queryFamilies.decisionImpact: The safety problem and 7 August 2027 forcing function are real, but family limits remain national and monitoring sits with SoHO entities and registries. The Commission platform is a role-controlled regulatory exchange, not proof that a startup can create the cross-border donor identity or compel network participation. KinLedger waits for authority sponsorship and a lawful identifier/interoperability design.

queryFamilies.purpose: Determine whether non-price renewable-auction promises create a scarce bid-to-built evidence product or remain auction-authority-specific qualification
queries: EU Net-Zero Industry Act Article 26 renewable auction non-price criteria guidance 2026
renewable auction cybersecurity resilience delivery prequalification implementation
queryFamilies.decisionImpact: Non-price criteria are now operational, but Commission guidance and national auction authorities define prequalification and award implementation. BidTwin waits and narrows to one auction and one evidence chain; no generic continuous compliance authority or awarded implementation budget was found.

queryFamilies.purpose: Test whether large-load electrical behavior is a distinct measurable object beyond queue readiness and conventional commissioning
queries: NERC characteristics risks emerging large loads ramp rate voltage sensitivity dynamic models
FERC large load reliability technical conference data center behavior
queryFamilies.decisionImpact: NERC confirms a distinct, high-consequence behavioral object: fast ramps, voltage sensitivity, protection, backup power, dynamic models, and internal segmentation. LoadEnvelope continues only as facility-to-utility model and test evidence; utility acceptance, protected telemetry, bespoke studies, and commissioning remain the control plane.

queryFamilies.purpose: Separate C2PA standards conformance from whole-pipeline production transformation failure
queries: C2PA conformance program official trust list conforming products
Content Authenticity Initiative open source C2PA SDK validation tool
queryFamilies.decisionImpact: C2PA owns formal conformance and trust-list qualification, while free SDKs and tooling implement signing and validation. ProvenanceChaos is killed as a generic conformance harness; re-entry requires authorized multi-platform transformation corpora and a buyer problem beyond standards compliance.

queryFamilies.purpose: Test whether an independent legal-authority graph is scarce after payment-network and OAuth-agent authorization protocols
queries: Visa Trusted Agent Protocol authorization signatures merchant agent intent
IETF AI agent authentication authorization OAuth transaction tokens 2026
queryFamilies.decisionImpact: Visa already binds agent, consumer intent, and payment context in commerce, while IETF drafts are actively specifying technical agent identity and authorization. EntityMandate waits and narrows to enterprise system-of-record translation and jurisdiction-specific legal review; a universal authority graph is not earned.

queryFamilies.purpose: Test whether a code-diff gate can determine substantial modification or must route a machinery change to qualified risk and conformity authority
queries: Regulation EU 2023/1230 physical or digital substantial modification new hazard increased risk
machinery software safety change manufacturer risk assessment conformity procedure
queryFamilies.decisionImpact: The Regulation creates a real digital-change boundary but makes the conclusion depend on hazards, risks, and protective measures in the physical machine context. RegDiff waits and narrows to evidence assembly and assessor routing; a CI diff cannot autonomously issue the legal or safety decision.

queryFamilies.purpose: Test whether continuous synthesis-screening assurance remains scarce after free open tools and a moving US policy control plane
queries: IBBIS Common Mechanism sequence screening performance free open source customer screening
Executive Order 14292 revised nucleic acid synthesis framework verifiable enforcement
queryFamilies.decisionImpact: IBBIS and SecureDNA absorb generic screening and benchmark functions, while Executive Order 14292 made the authoritative federal framework a moving control surface. BioScreen CI waits unless a provider supplies an authorized, safely governed operational corpus and pays for assurance beyond its native and consortium controls.

queryFamilies.purpose: Separate the Data Act's access and quality duties from an assumed commercial service-level guarantee
queries: Regulation EU 2023/2854 Article 4 same quality without undue delay continuously real time
Data Act connected product readily available data metadata technical feasibility security dispute
queryFamilies.decisionImpact: Article 4 creates a testable same-quality, metadata, timeliness, and where-feasible continuous/real-time boundary, but readily available scope, technical feasibility, security, and dispute processes constrain it. DataRight SLO continues only as authorized feed observability against explicit product and contract expectations, never as an inferred statutory SLA.

queryFamilies.purpose: Test whether public hosting-capacity maps can support a bankable grid-ready property market
queries: DOE atlas hosting capacity maps site specific interconnection disclaimer utilities
FERC large load site control readiness speculative requests interconnection
queryFamilies.decisionImpact: Public maps are useful screening primitives but DOE explicitly says they do not answer site-specific interconnection and users must work with utilities. FERC's site-control/readiness work further locates authority with the grid process. PowerPlot waits and narrows to a dated diligence packet; the broad marketplace cannot advertise bankable capacity.

queryFamilies.purpose: Determine the enforceable scope of automated-worker-decision review and whether a generic workforce ledger matches it
queries: Directive EU 2024/2831 human oversight override account termination platform work
Directive EU 2024/2831 human review explanation substantiated reply two weeks transposition
queryFamilies.decisionImpact: The Directive creates a concrete explanation, authorized human oversight, review, rectification, and two-week response workflow for digital labour platforms. It does not establish a universal all-employer ledger. WorkerDecision Ledger waits for one platform and Member State implementation, narrowed to workflow evidence that preserves actual human authority and worker rights.
